_doc: Per-part settings keyed by part name (source of truth, set by whoever designs the part). _defaults apply to every part without its own entry; there is no default material (a printed part without one reports material null). process (print setup, resolved by checks/process.py): printer (printers.json), material (materials.json), nozzle_mm (default: the material's recommended nozzle), layer_height_mm and line_width_mm (default: the printer's values for that nozzle), up (manifest-frame direction away from the bed = layer normal, '+x' ... or a vector), plate_yaw_deg (turn about up on the plate, default 0), material_alternatives (other materials the part may be printed in), printed (overrides the role rule), seeded / seeded_keys (values derived from old free text, FEM axes or a bed-contact estimate, not yet confirmed: delete them when the designer confirms), layer_normal_axes (axes studied in the FEM runs; null = not set). expected_hardware: counts the checks compare with what the manifest contains. covers (shell parts): parts the shell covers, the vertical axis (x, y) the inner wall faces, and the lowest z of the inner wall that is measured. exact_fit.min_solid_mm3: only the STEP solids of at least this volume take part in the exact fit (a servo's housing without its internal gears). loadpath_slices: {axis, range_mm, n_slices} of the part's load-bearing span for the slab-area / severed-branch measurement (null = not set; values of the four R arm connectors are the arm study's STAGE_SLICE_SPECS). fem: per-part FEM setup (format in checks/fem_core.py); migrated from the old per-study scripts. geometry_thresholds: {sliver_mm2, micro_edge_mm, acute_normal_deg, g1_kink_deg}, what the geometry check counts as an event (smaller planar face, shorter planar edge with a bend over 10 deg, edge normal angle above, cylinder/plane kink up to); defaults = the old leg values, a part's own entry changes only the keys it names. loadpath_slices source: where set_by says so, axis and range are the dominant-axis span between the centroid of the part's FEM support holes and of its FEM load holes (checks/fem_core.holes_near), a first reading to be confirmed by the designer.

_printed._doc: Parts whose role is listed are printed parts (coverage counts them); a part's process.printed overrides this.
